comment: Steps: set 2, gamepad [] (no controller: word 0xffffff, every bit 1), wait 10. Selection writes ui_in 0, set writes 2 (the new base), the report is written over base 2 at time 0. The pass ends at 10: rst_n low 10, high 12; then, because a report was sent, it is sent again at 12 (base 2), and only then do the steps restart at 12: set 2, then the report again. Levels for all-ones data: bit 0: 64,96,64; bits 1..23: 96,64 each (data level unchanged so left out); latch: 80 (64|16), 64, 0. 52 levels.
